description.text: The study period of this Project is preliminarily set at two years with four semesters including a compulsory 30 credits. I. Program name: Chinese Law; Period of Study: 2 years The students in this program will be expected to spend the entire first year in China to complete most of academic courses, while the second year will be open for internship experience (either in china or other countries). II. Research directions Chinese Legal Theory, Chinese Civil and Commercial Jurisprudence, Chinese Constitution and Administrative Jurisprudence, International Jurisprudence III. Course schedule and credit requirements Two-year study period with 30 credits in 5 links and a master dissertation, consisting of 6 compulsory courses (18 credits), 5 optional courses (10 credits) and 4 weeks of probation (2 credits). 1. Compulsory courses (6 courses, totally 18 credits) 1) Public Courses [1] Chinese culture (3 credits) [2] Chinese language (3 credits), three teaching hours per week, which will be taught by International College of Chinese Studies of Renmin University in the first semester, and by the School of Law in the second semester. 2) Specialized Courses [1] Introduction to Chinese Law (3 credits) [2] Administrative and Criminal Jurisprudence (substantive law I) (3 credits) [3] Civil, Commercial and Economic Jurisprudence (substantive law II) (3 credits) [4] Procedural Jurisprudence (3 credits) 2. Optional Courses (totally 10 credits for five courses chosen from nine courses) [1] Property Law (2 credits) [2] Comparative Land Law and Policy Regulation (2 credits) [3] Comparative Commercial Law (2 credits) [4] Labor Law (2 credits) [5] Chinese Intellectual Property Law (2 credits) [6] Chinese Criminal Procedure Law (2 credits) [7] Chinese Economic Jurisprudence (2 credits) [8] Chinese Legislative and Executive Systems (2 credits) [9] Chinese Financial Law (2 credits) IV. Master Dissertation After successful completion of all items required in the cultivation plan for their respective programs, the Master’s degree postgraduates should, under the supervision of their tutors, write a master dissertation. Only those who have successfully defended their dissertations shall be conferred the master degree. V. Lawyer probation and social survey (2 credits) Starting in the third semester with the duration no less than 4 weeks.

duration.text: The Master of Chinese Law at Renmin University of China is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3916 USD/per year ￥ 28200 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of undergraduate school 5. Two recommendation letters(optional) From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 6. Certificate of English proficiency test IELTS or TOEFl will only be required if the applicant is not a native English speaker. 7. Personal Statement Personal Statement with the applicant's signature, written in Chinese or in English. You can download a template or sample from here. 8. Copies of article or papers published Sample copies of published academic articles, awards or other research outputs

requirements.text: 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport and under 40 years old 2. Hold a Bachelor degree or above 3. With recommendations of two associate professors or higher, providing a certificate of competence in English
